verdict.rationale: Airwallex is a spend and finance platform, so AI-driven GL coding across entities is a fair axis. The pack shows only syncing approved card expenses to an ERP and general spend reconciliation. Nothing documents AI assigning GL codes, multi-entity coding, or close acceleration. AgentOS covers agents acting on accounts (balances, beneficiaries, cards, cashflow reports), not GL categorization, so it is adjacent at most.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI automatically assign GL codes to transactions across entities to accelerate close
